governance.decisionForum: During Year One mobilisation, 4.1.1 should operate through the Digital Student Experience Hub governance with a cross-institution knowledge and content working layer bringing together SASD, Communications/web, Digital and IT, relevant faculties, representative student-facing services/directorates and authoritative subject owners. Material policy, platform or ownership decisions should be referred to the institutional forums that hold the relevant authority rather than creating a separate parallel governance structure.
governance.decisionScope: The institution-wide map of student-facing knowledge domains and the roadmap to exhaustive coverage; the SASD-first implementation boundary and criteria for sequencing later services/directorates; the boundary of authoritative student knowledge; content inclusion and exclusion rules; separation of student-facing knowledge, transient opportunity content and staff operational guidance; taxonomy and metadata principles; authoritative ownership; authoring and editorial permissions; approval, review, expiry and quality standards; priority domains and migration sequencing; use of King’s Answers as the first proving environment; the relationship with the Digital Student Experience Hub, web/DXP channels and enquiry management; rationalisation or retirement of competing content; the evidence loop from search and enquiries; protected content-design and migration capacity; and the enduring institutional knowledge operating model.
governance.businessAsUsualOwner: TBC – enduring institutional owner for student knowledge and content operations
governance.businessAsUsualOwnershipNote: Mark Peace is accountable for mobilisation within the Digital Student Experience Hub. SASD provides the first detailed implementation environment but should not become the assumed long-term boundary or owner of all institutional student knowledge. The enduring foundation requires a clear institutional owner with authority to steward standards, editorial controls, lifecycle expectations and cross-channel reuse across services and directorates, while subject owners remain accountable for the accuracy of their domains. The final BAU location should be resolved through Year One governance and operating-model work rather than assumed from the current ownership of King’s Answers, CRM, the web estate or any single service.
